title.narrative: Jilin Yanji Low-Carbon Climate-Resilient Healthy City Project

description.narrative:
The project is located in Yanji city, which faces challenges of poor urban livability and traffic management, exposure to climate-related flood risk, and risks to water security and safety. The project will provide multiple cross-benefits from an integrated solution provided to improve the urban livability of a medium-sized city, which is timely and essential to lessen the migration to the coastal mega-urban regions and to provide a demonstration project for replication in the PRC. It will contribute to (i) regional public goods of health and improved air and water quality, and (ii) revitalizing the economically challenged northeast area of the PRC.
The project will support the first bus rapid transit (BRT) corridor in the northeast of the PRC and transform Yanji's urban geography. This will reinforce the east-west linear city arrangement through connecting key areas following principles of transit-oriented development (TOD) with higher density mixed-use and pedestrian-friendly center areas around the BRT stations. It will integrate nonmotorized transport (NMT) lanes and facilities along the corridor, and a series of small roads and river greenways will be provided to ensure safe and pleasant pedestrian and bicycle access to the BRT stations while promoting low-carbon urban mobility and physical activities that enhance public health. The project-supported greenways are designed as "sponge city" green infrastructure, enhancing climate resilience and urban livability. The project will improve the water supply and wastewater management systems to ensure safe and climate-resilient access to water supply and improved water quality. Capacity development will contribute to the preparation of action plans to demonstrate Yanji as a low-carbon, climate-resilient, and healthy city, contributing to the implementation of the Healthy China 2030 program, and lessons and knowledge will be shared with other developing member countries.

title.narrative: Reports and Recommendations of the President
Reports and Recommendations of the President
Loan 3876: 77% of contracts awarded and 51% disbursed as of 10 Jun 2025

Progress Toward Outcome: As of Dec 2024, the BRT phase I of 7.6 kilometers and 10 platforms located in the central part of BRT corridor has been opened to traffic in August 2022. BRT Phase II Located in the western and eastern sections of the BRT corridor which includes 11.42 kilometers of BRT corridor, public space and slow-moving systems, the Phase is under planning. Clean-energy BRT buses have been purchased and put into use, the new bus terminal will be constructed. 17.7km of riverside pedestrian and 9km connecting have been completed. Flow meters and smart meters were procured and under installation. The project implement period has elapsed 75%. Cumulative project contract awards reached $101.84 million and cumulative disbursemen reached $67.06 million.
Some results are in the Audited Project Financial Statements | Jun 2024: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/50322/50322-002-apfs-en_1.pdf
Some results are in the Social Monitoring Reports | Mar 2025: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/50322/50322-002-smr-en_4.pdf

Status of Implementation Progress: 1a. The BRT corridor was updated from 20 km to 19 km at preliminary design, and construction was divided into two phases. Phase I (7.6 km and 10 stations) has been completed and put into use in August 2022. Based on the current economic development status and BRT phase I operation experience, regarding the remaining 11.4 km BRT phase II, YCG confirmed that: (i) about 2.75 km eastern corridor and 4 stations (BRT-W6) will be implemented immediately for completion in early 2026. (ii) The new airport, as one of major tasks in the 14th five-year plan of Yanbian prefecture government, will start construction within 2015, therefore, about 5.2 km west corridor and 5 stations, connecting to the new airport, will be implemented in 2025-2026. (iii) the remaining about 3.45 km eastern section will not be constructed and therefore be removed from the project scope.
1b. 20 clean-energy BRT buses purchased and put into use. More buses will be procured in the following years. The new bus terminal will be constructed when a suitable place is identified. Meanwhile a terminal near to the BRT command center is used for BRT buses temporarily.
1c. 28 km of riverside pedestrian and 9 km of connecting links were planned in the preliminary design, totaling 37 km, all of which are to be constructed using government funds. 17.7 km of riverside pedestrian and 9 km of connecting links have been completed, the remaining pedestrian paths are being implemented along Chaoyang River in 2025-2026.
1d. 8 plazas (West High Speed Rail Station Square, Yanbian Government Station Square, People's Park Square, Wolong Park, Xingguangwan Park, Dayu Park, Wenshan Park, and Boxue Park) have been completed using government funds.
1e. Being implemented. The BRT demonstration section eliminated 2 sidewalk parking lots on Gongyuan Road. 100 new parking equipment has been procured, will explore suitable places for installation.
1f. Along with the BRT, completed about 15 km (two sides of the BRT corridor phase 1).
1g. All BRT buses installed priority seating for people with special needs. Newly purchased 20 BRT buses, each with 5 priority seats.
1h. The ITS command center was established and operational.
1i. During the construction period, 1,136 jobs had been created. Of these, 21% were borne by women and 23% by low-income persons; Women hold 31% of skilled jobs.
2a. Yanji government used domestic funds (from central government) to conduct 3.7 km Chaoyang river improvement works (with 90% completed of the eastern bank so far and western bank to be implemented after domestic approval of the preliminary design).
2b. More than 8,000 square meters of green space integrating physical activity areas for all ages have been completed using governments own funds. Design institute and CS5 consultant (when on board) will assist YGM to identify how some sponge city features could be incorporated into some of those green space.
2c. Currently, completed 15.8 km drainage works along BRT corridor (14 km along BRT phase 1 and 1.8 km along BRT 2) and 9.9 km drainage works along BRT corridor (8.1 km along BRT phase 1 and 1.8 km along BRT phase 2); another 45.2 km drainage and 58.9 km wastewater were completed by construction bureau using governments own funds in 2023 and 2024; two rainstorm water pump stations were constructed. In 2025-2026, the construction bureau will implement additional wastewater pipeline works as planned by the government.
2d. 582 jobs were created during project implementation, with 22% for local low-income people and 20% for women during implementation.
3a. 362 (327 installed on site and 35 spares, 212 installed) flow meters and 4,080 (80 spares) smart meters (3,264 meters have been installed in households) were procured and installation is in progress. About 70% completed, the remaining will be completed by end of 2025.
3b. Sor far completed about 29.5 km of which 20 km replacement of leaking water supply pipes have been completed by government using its own funds, and 9.5 km (out of 14.5 km) completed under WS-W1. The remaining works of WS-W1 cannot be implemented due to the inaccessibility of the sites and will be removed from the contract.
3c. 164 jobs were created in total, including 54 filled up by low-income persons (61%) and 6 filled up by women (3%).
